regex/range#

RegexRange describes a half-open interval [start, end) inside regex input.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let range = RegexRange(start: 2, end: 5);
range.start();  // 2
range.end();    // 5
range.length(); // 3

Description#

RegexRange describes a half-open interval [start, end) inside regex input. Every position counts Unicode scalar values from zero, never UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units. The end position is excluded, so length is end - start.

A non-empty match over scalar positions 2, 3 and 4:

Empty matches have equal boundaries and are valid:

RegexRange(start: 4, end: 4).length(); // 0

For example, in "a😀я" the range [1, 3) covers two Unicode scalar values. Their encoded byte widths do not affect either boundary.
